Name: More Junimo Chests
Author: Nullnnow
Description:
Adds several new Junimo Chests, each with their own inventory.  These chests are fully compatible with the Automate mod, with the intention to help organize large networks. These chests can be obtained by tailoring a Junimo Chest with one of the following items:
[list]
[*]Amethyst[/*]
[*]Aquamarine[/*]
[*]Celestine[/*]
[*]Diamond[/*]
[*]Earth Crystal[/*]
[*]Emerald[/*]
[*]Fairy Stone[/*]
[*]Fire Quartz[/*]
[*]Froze Tear[/*]
[*]Jade[/*]
[*]Marble[/*]
[*]Quartz[/*]
[*]Ruby[/*]
[*]Star Shards[/*]
[*]Topaz[/*]
[/list]These chests can be converted back to the default Junimo Chest by tailoring them with a piece of cloth.

[b]Even More Junimo Chests?!?![/b]
Version 2.0.0 adds two new Junimo Chests that can't be obtained by tailoring. Below describes how to obtain them and what they do.
[spoiler]This mod adds a medium and large variant of the Junimo Chest, offering even more storage. These chests can be purchased from Mr. Qi's gem shop for 30 and 50 Qi gems respectively.[/spoiler]
[b]Compatibility With Mods that Edit Junimo Chest Texture[/b]
This mod[b] [/b]changes the texture of the normal Junimo Chest. This behavior can be disabled by setting the "Replace Default Junimo Chest Texture" config option to false. Doing so will ensure that any mods that change the look of Junimo Chests will still be applied.

[b]Migrating from v1.0.0 to v2.0.0[/b]
If you encounter any bugs or have any Earth Crystal chests from v1.0.0, please consult this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4360]migration guide[/url] first.
